name: veyq-site
//: The published documentation (ADR 0087): Use, Run and Security, built by Astro + Starlight to static files in dist/. Deliberately OUTSIDE the root pnpm workspace, with its own pnpm-workspace.yaml (its overrides) and pnpm-lock.yaml: the workspace exists for @veyq/crypto alone, and the site shares no code with src/web/ or src/admin-web/. Installed through the same deprecated-package gate as every package: `python3 scripts/pnpm_install_no_deprecated.py --package-dir site` from the repo root. `packageManager` is the root's pin (scripts/validate_pnpm_installs_gated.py holds the two equal).
//engines: The Node the site's tree supports: astro >=22.12.0 and postcss-nested 8 (the override in pnpm-workspace.yaml) ^22.0.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0, so an odd, non-LTS release such as 23 is outside it. CI runs Node 22, as for the root workspace.
//dependencies: sharp is declared although nothing here imports it: Astro's image service loads it at build time from the built chunks, and Astro asks for it only as an optional dependency. npm hoisted it to node_modules/sharp; pnpm links only what this package declares, and without it `astro build` fails with MissingSharp (measured 2026-11-03).
